newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil publishes CVRD auction rules.
newsitem.headline: Brazil publishes CVRD auction rules.

text.p: Consortia or groups of investors who wish to participate in the privatization auction of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) must have capital of at least 500 million reais ($500 million), the government said on Friday.
Rules for the action, set for mid-February, were published in the government's official gazette.
The company is to be privatized in three stages. A block sale of 40-45 percent of voting shares will be auctioned in mid-February on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.

Immediately after the block sale, 5.11 percent of CVRD's capital stock will be offered to employees, followed by a public offering of the remaining shares held by the government on international and domestic markets later in 1997.
The government owns 76 percent of CVRD's voting capital, equivalent to 51 percent of the company's total capital.

The investors who acquire the 40-45 percent block will have to create, within 15 days of the February auction, a special purpose company (SPE) which must retain all all of the CVRD shares for at least five years.
Individual shareholders of the SPE are barred from holding more than 45 percent of the voting or total capital of the SPE in the first five years of its existence.
There are also rules to restrict the takeover of CVRD by major producers and traders of iron ore or steel.
Steel producers of more than 8.5 million tonnes a year and iron ore producers and traders of more than 30 million tonnes annually will be limited to buying a maximum of 10 percent of the block sale.

The government will maintain two "golden shares" -- one in the SPE to ensure its rules will be observed for five years, and the other a permanent veto over changes in CVRD's iron ore, railway and ports business interests, as well as changes in the company's name and location of its headquarters.
The minimum price of the initial share block, means of payment, and the date of the auction will be announced at least 45 days before the sale, as will the rules of the employee share offer.
The rules of the public offer will be published after the auction.

CVRD's minority shareholders have the right to offer their shares for sale along with the auction if they register their intention to do so 30 days prior to the auction, or they may associate themselves with the new SPE after privatization.
CVRD is to issue debentures to protect the interests of its shareholders with regard to certain mining rights.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 507 4151
